For this small rented plot of 0.20 hectares, I plant root crops which do well here in the South South with our rains. I will not buy chemical fertilizer because it is too costly for a rented plot this size, and for cassava or yam it is not common here. I also will not hire workers since my family and I can manage the clearing, mounding, planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves. I use our own local cuttings and setts that we have kept from last season, and with our good rainfall I have no need for irrigation.
